formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) is the defining ether-sulfate anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (4); no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Few refatting counter-signals (Glyceryl Oleate 6, Ascorbyl Palmitate 14); none moves the convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system, Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (8, prominent), plus light routes (Glyceryl Oleate 6, Ascorbyl Palmitate 14, humectants Panthenol 11 and Glycerin 15). C2 not met: no early silicone or prominent payload lipid, no pearlizing route.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Only one polymer and weak refatters; a cleansing-led reading (low) is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: the only deposition is one light cationic guar plus weak refatters, facing an effective buffered SLES chassis; no silicone, lipid, protein or film former.

depositionLoad.rationale: One cationic guar (8) and two weak refatters (6, 14).

persistence.rationale: Guar deposit is light and rinse-sensitive; refatters weakly retained; nothing persistent.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES + betaine + glucoside ordinary chassis.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: A single light polymer and weak refatters with moderate reset match the low anchor (no polymer floor).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families are present, but the only ones are one light guar and weak_refatter esters (plus humectants); no persistent silicone, lipid, protein or film converges, and an effective SLES chassis removes the light residue.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Guar charge density/level unknown; could make residue noticeable (neighbor moderate).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Formula has a recognized anti-dandruff active Piroctone Olamine (13) plus Zinc PCA (10); scalp_active needs a qualifying claim (7.2). Care-direction verdict for lengths: nonspecific.

usageRole.rationale: Default; treatment possible only if a dandruff claim (U3) is revealed, since dandruffSupport is supported.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met: prominent Panthenol (11) comfort route; Glycerin (15), Glyceryl Oleate (6) humectant/refatting routes.
